title: What’s New in MiiTuber 0.2.2
items: Added Auto blink, next to Show body in the top bar. Your avatar blinks on its own every few seconds, even when the camera is off.
While Auto blink is on, quick blinks from the camera are ignored so your avatar doesn't double-blink. Closing your eyes for about half a second still shows on your avatar.
Turn Auto blink off to go back to camera-only blinking. MiiTuber remembers your choice.
footer:
The macOS build is unsigned and not notarized. On first launch, Control-click MiiTuber, choose Open, and confirm Open. If it is still blocked, allow MiiTuber under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

NOTE: Mii Creator custom features do not work with MiiTuber.
